content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from thekoreatimes_officialSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inthekoreatimes_official•FollowMore optionsthekoreatimes_official 6dK-pop juggernaut BTS has released its fifth full-length album, “ARIRANG,” marking the group’s first collective studio project in nearly four years and signaling what the members have described as the start of a new era: “BTS 2.0.”The 14-track album arrives three years and nine months after the anthology record “Proof,” issued in June 2022.
